confidence_notes: The July meal, coffee and draft beer estimates draw on a small crowdsourced sample. [Numbeo Havana](https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Havana) The cocktail and house wine estimates use local menu prices relative to beer. [D’Next](https://dnext-havana.com/es/menu), [Luna Café](https://lunacafehabana.com/) Peso and dollar pricing can differ. Lodging is modeled, with registered dorm beds especially uncertain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Havana’s own lodging mix is the benchmark. Licensed casas particulares inform the basic guesthouse estimate, and conventional city hotels inform the three-star estimate.
